terminals.name: opensky-proxy
terminals.description: OpenSky API proxy (Python stdlib) on http://127.0.0.1:8000. Handles OAuth token refresh and rate-limit headers. Runs anonymously unless OPENSKY_CLIENT_ID and OPENSKY_CLIENT_SECRET are set.

terminals.name: meridian-web
terminals.description: Meridian React dev server (Vite) on http://127.0.0.1:5173. Proxies /api/* to the OpenSky proxy on :8000.
